title: Rosen Δ tip — internal PoC oracle
subtitle: Model–Relation closure + measurable delta — not world acceptance
tip: Validate (M,R) then Δ. If the model cannot predict the next measurable state, you have narrative — not PoC.

rosen_mr.M: Model — explicit procedure, equation, or state machine for what should happen
rosen_mr.R: Relation — how model outputs map to observable reality (instrument, survey, log, artifact)
rosen_mr.anticipation: System or student can state expected next state before running — not only explain after success

delta.meaning: Bounded change in a livelihood-relevant measurand between baseline and run
delta.reject_if: Only qualitative praise; no baseline; delta attributed to world acceptance

verdicts.PASS: All internal oracles satisfied; bracket receipt written
verdicts.HOLD: Missing M, R, Δ, receipt, or livelihood signal under 32.8% doctrine
verdicts.REJECT_WORLD_ORACLE: Submission tried to validate via popularity, funding, or external ACK without receipts
